# Install Greeter

Copy the script somewhere on your PATH, then check that it runs.

## Copy the script

Copy it into a folder your shell searches:

```sh
cp src/greet.sh /usr/local/bin/greet
```

## Check it works

Pass it a name and read the line it prints:

```sh
greet Sam
```

Go back to the [overview](../README.md) for the list of what it prints.
